decisions.decision: The MA Broadband Project/Implementation update from the IT Director was tabled until the 2/18/2014 BOS meeting.
decisions.quote: update on ma broadband project/implementation from it director: tabled until the 2/18/2014 bos meeting.

decisions.decision: Mr. Toale will schedule a meeting with the Building Reuse Committee group, propose a new charter, and report any vacancies to the BOS.
decisions.quote: mr. toale will schedule a meeting with the group to discuss who would like to remain on the committee, propose developing a new charter, and will report back any vacancies to the bos.

decisions.decision: No action on rescinding PACC appointments this evening; PACC staff hours will need to be approved by the Town Manager, and the PACC cannot meet or make decisions until quorum is met.
decisions.quote: nothing can be done this evening about rescinding appointments and moving forward pacc staff hours will need to be approved by the town manager.

decisions.decision: The Town Manager was asked to investigate whether the BOS could rescind the PACC appointments under BOS policies.
decisions.quote: mr. ebersole added that he was unsure if the bos could rescind the pacc appointments due to bos policies and he would like for the town manager to investigate that.

decisions.decision: Mr. Alonzo will review the suggested PACC Bylaw changes with the Town Manager, and all changes will be placed on the warrant for Annual Town Meeting.
decisions.quote: mr. alonzo will review these suggested changes with the town manager and all changes will be place on the warrant for annual town meeting.

decisions.decision: The Flat Hill Road dilapidated building issue (asbestos) was forwarded to the Town Manager for investigation regarding sale or demolition.
decisions.quote: this issue will be forwarded to the town manager for further investigatior regarding either the sale or demolition of the property.
